en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional love song. 'Рудо јагне' as 'ruddy lamb' (рудо = reddish, fleecy) and 'лудо' as an affectionate 'silly' are my reading.

lines.lat: Stojane more, dilbere, more džanam,

lines.cyr: оти не дојде, лудо, синоќа?
